item.title: U.S. Supreme Court Strikes Down Trump Tariffs
item.description: In a 6-3 decision, the court ruled the tariffs, including sweeping reciprocal tariffs, to be unconstitutional.

item.title: Conta-Clip Debuts FDA-Compliant Cable Entries
item.description: The cable entries, which consist of a polyamide frame with injected elastomer, have integrated locking hooks for easy installation.

item.title: The Data Dilemma: Why AI Fails for Mid-Sized Food Processors
item.description: It is critical for manufacturers such as food processors to recognize that while AI has the potential to become the "turbocharger" of operations, that transformation rarely happens by simply bolting on use cases.

item.title: NORD Introduces Digital Twins for Virtual Commissioning
item.description: This technology allows engineers to verify early in the planning process whether the drive concept is suitable for the system, reducing the project timeline and achieving greater efficiency and availability.

item.title: Engineering for Uncertainty: How to Build Flexibility into Food Plant Design
item.description: In an environment defined by rapid consumer shifts, long term success depends not on guessing the future correctly, but on ensuring the facility can adapt when the future shifts.

item.title: Leveraging Packaging Technology and Design for a Safer Food Supply
item.description: A food manufacturer’s packaging line represents both the last opportunity to protect food and the last place where risk can be introduced. Treating the packaging line as a critical control point is essential to moving from reactive compliance to proactive prevention.

item.title: VIDEO | Food Plant Openings and Expansions January 2026

item.title: Puratos Partners with California Cultured to Commercialize Cultured Cocoa
item.description: Together, the two companies aim to commercialize a cultured chocolate product for professionals and food brands.

item.title: Mars to Purchase Renewable Energy from Swedish Wind Farm
